description: The Nitish Kumar government has been trying to fix the state's tangled land records for more than a decade.
body_lead: New Delhi: Bihar government formed an Artificial Intelligence committee for its Revenue and Land Reforms department to make the process quicker and more transparent. It’s the first state in the country to set up such a committee. The committee has a mandate to study the management of land records and the ongoing land survey, and to use modern technology for it.
